title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC!

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, so... Our next meeting is Wednesday night, and we have that interview on Saturday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, we have a little bit of a gap...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, hang on. I think they wanted to move this meeting to a different day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was about to schedule us for something else here. I need to not forget about stuff like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's great that we've been receiving so many offers, but this is starting to become too much for just us to handle...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku's even been helping me with this lately, which has made things easier compared to before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't give enough respect to people who manage idols. How do they do it...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? A message?
Oh, it could be another offer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: F-For TV...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I couldn't be more grateful that people want us to appear. And it looks like they want us on for one of their segments. I wonder what it's about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, they want us to report on a cafe!
I think that's a first for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really wanna do this since I'm pretty good at this sort of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I gotta let the others know...!
bgm_area00002
A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late!
I hope I didn't keep you waiting... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, hello.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait...
Minori isn't here yet?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, she's on classroom duty today, so she'll be running a little late.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She sounded very excited.
I remember her saying, “I'm gonna write the best log entry ever!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like she's trying to get the most out of regular school life before she goes credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I guess we can start discussing our next stream and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Airi and the others are here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haruka told us the good news!
You get to go on TV again, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're reporting on a cafe, right?
What does that involve exactly?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a segment for a show called “The Late Nite Wednesday Talk Show”, and we get to introduce a cafe in Shibuya that's been getting a lot of buzz.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's hosted by a popular idol and TV personality, and the show itself has been getting pretty good ratings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? Then, this is a huge offer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The show's producer was apparently looking for some high schoolers who knew Shibuya well, which led them to us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The producer contacted you directly?
This must've been a big decision.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's proof that everyone in TV is talking about MORE MORE JUMP! now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, that may be a part of it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's actually quite common for staff we have worked with before to refer us as guests for TV gigs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. As a result, in terms of landing these appearances, who you know ends up being more important than how famous you are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Either way, I'm really happy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So that's how it works.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I have to think the staff referred you girls because of all the hard work you've done up until now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing it air.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
We'll bring over a video after it does!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, this is so exciting♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you know which cafe you'll be going to?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, they said they're still working out the details. We should receive word once everything's finalized.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Everyone!
I have big news! No, huge news!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, hello.
I hope classroom duty went well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's going on? Why do you sound so flustered?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-S-S-So...
That cafe we're supposed to introduce...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They picked the one where I work!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, what are the odds...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But there's a bit of a problem...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A bit of a problem?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
During the day of the shoot, they're gonna be short on staff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Short on staff...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A big group made a reservation on the same day as our shoot, which was okay since someone with years of experience had a shift scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But they can't make it now because of a family matter...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One person agreed to fill in, but we're afraid that it's gonna be too much for them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no. That's terrible...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you can't help because of the shoot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Our hands are tied because I'm not available!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On top of all that, the manager's been wishing for the longest time that our cafe would get a TV spot. I was so happy at first when I heard the news...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But at this rate, the cafe won't be able to handle a TV shoot, let alone run properly. Which means they might have to turn down this offer...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well...
I'm sure the manager really wants to do this, so it might be good to tell the show's staff that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Would it be possible for someone to work there just for a day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you know someone who can?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I think I know just the person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only do they work part-time as front-end staff for retail, they can do quite a lot. Cooking, prepping or waiting tables should be a cinch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's no guarantee that they'll agree to help...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please ask them!
I'll let the manager know what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Got it.
Then, I'll try asking them.
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, that rain asset can go here and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, this doesn't look right...
It feels too simple. I wanna give it more of a twist...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
They have that lace set available on the store! Maybe this is my chance to try it out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This melody feels kinda heavy, so some cute late assets could be like invoking fun memories of the past and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's give it a go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really liked it because it looked so cute, so I should take this opportunity to buy them! Now, where'd that bookmark go...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! The ones with the highest resolution cost 10,000 yen?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Th-That's a bit outta my reach...
I don't have much money left to spend because I already bought so many this month.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nnnghhh... But I've got such a clear picture in my head for this video! What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? A message?
At this time? Who could be...?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line:
<Evening, Mizuki!
I wanted to ask you for a small favor. Are you free now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's Airi!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uhh... <Yeah, what's up?>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line: <So... Actually, it might take too long to type this all out. Lemme call you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there we go!
Hello?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Hello? Mizuki
Sorry, I know it's really late.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nah, that's totally fine!
Anyway, what's up...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Remember that cafe we went to with Ena the other day?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember!
The one where the staff all wear those adorable uniforms, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's it.
They're in a bit of a bind and need someone to fill in for a day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
You'll get to wear their uniform and be paid the same day! Also...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes! Sign me up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get to wear something that cute and get paid for it?! Talk about the best job ever!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I wanna do it!
No, please let me do it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Wh-Whoa, I wasn't expecting you to jump on it so quickly...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Getting to wear that uniform's important, but I was also just in need of some spending money...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Oh, really?
Then, I'm glad I decided to ask you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, your timing couldn't have been better!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At the same time, Airi, why are you looking for someone to work there...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Oh, that's actually a funny story.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A funny story?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, the thing is...>
The day of the shoot
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We're MORE MORE JUMP!
Thank you for having us today!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome.
Thank you all for being here today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We appreciate you agreeing to meet with us like this. We know you run a busy establishment, but we felt it was important to get our bearings before our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, since our goal is to do this cafe justice by introducing all its best qualities.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hehe. I appreciate your diligence.
Of course, I'd be more than happy to help you all with that.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Please feel free to look around as much as you like before the shoot. Minori, would you mind being their guide...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Is the person I introduced already here by chance?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Ah, yes!
Akiyama should be changing right now. I'm sure that in a minute or two...
Oh, you guys are already here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Welcome to carino/carina♪
Well, you get the gist...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, wait! Minori, I've never seen you in your new uniform in person until now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You look absolutely amazing!
A million times better than seeing it through a screen!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
This cafe's uniform also looks really cute on you, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, I couldn't agree more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's like you've been working here this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?!
I can't help but blush when you shower me with that much praise...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, more importantly!
You're doing a shoot here today, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't believe I get to see my favorite group do one live...! I'm so glad I agreed to this! Seriously, best job ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you're so excited about this, Mizuki. You were definitely the right person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you for finding someone who could help, Minori, Momoi! You two really saved the day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, um...
What do you need me to do today?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Ah, of course. I haven't given you the rundown yet. I'll be asking you to wait tables and do some light work in the kitchen.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The girl who's going to help you with that should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, Saki.
I didn't know you had a shift today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Airi...?!
Wait, you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really excited about this shoot! I've been looking forward to working with you all today...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I couldn't believe it when Minori and our boss told me that you'd be doing a shoot here and I get to see it with my own eyes! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Okay, Saki.
I know you're excited about today's shoot, but I need your A-game today because we're joined by Akiyama here today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you! I'm Saki Tenma!
I'm looking forward to working with you today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm Mizuki Akiyama.
I'm also looking forward to working with you... Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you happen to have an older brother...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? Oh, yes!
His name's Tsukasa Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I knew it!
No one else has your guys' last name!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I also go to Kamiyama High and talk to him a lot! I've even gotten to see a few of his shows!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
What a coincidence! I had no idea that you both knew each other!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. I know, right?!
Again, I'm looking forward to working with you today! So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Can I call you Saki?
I'm guessing we're the same age...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! I'm in my first year of high school, so please call me whatever you like!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, we are the same age!
Call me Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, really?!
It makes me so happy to make new friends who are the same age!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's really cute.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You two seem to be really hitting it off! Saki will be in charge of teaching you what to do today, Akiyama, so feel free to ask her anything.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Your tasks will be fairly simple...
We'll need you to wait and bus tables... As for kitchen work, you'll be placing the finishing touches on desserts and such by adding fruits and chocolate to them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Waiting, bussing and finishing touches... Okay, I think I can handle that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm actually pretty good at decorating stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you are?!
That's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do our best together, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, we should get back to work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The film crew should be here in about half an hour, so let's take in as much as we can until then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
I'll be taking them around the cafe now!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Understood.
Akiyama, come this way and we can try making some of these menu items together...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm ready to learn!
One hour later
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Rolling in...!
Four, three...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Ready to catch another...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Big wave?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Cowabunga!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's see what's hot right now!
It's trend surfing time!!!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Hey, what do you think they're doing at that booth over there? It's all covered in curtains!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Oh, when we came in, one of the waiters said that they're gonna be doing a shoot for TV or something here today.

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
That means some celebrities are here, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
I get to see a TV shoot take place literally right in front of me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
And everyone in MMJ's sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is the show that airs late at night on Wednesdays, right?! I sort of have this attachment to it since I watch it all the time while I'm working on stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
I didn't know it aired so late at night!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's been gaining a lot of traction lately!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And as fun as it is to see them shoot an episode, I can't wait to see it on TV♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now then!
Today, we're visiting a cafe called “carino/carina” located on Main Street in Shibuya!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lately, their new Mount Everest strawberry parfait has been going totally viral on social media.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I saw some pictures and couldn't believe what I saw. It really is a mountain of strawberries and whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we get to try it today, right?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yes!
Not only does it look spectacular, it also tastes wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: So, bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
O-Oh my...
It's much bigger than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And all these strawberries...
This has to be a month's worth... No, several months worth all in one place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't forget the whipped cream...
I'm really glad we decided to split it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I doubt one person could ever eat all this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At the same time, I get why everyone wants to post their pictures on social media. It looks adorable!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We're off to a good start.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori in particular is doing a good job of acting like it's her first time here. I was worried at first that her reactions wouldn't feel natural...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But she's on a roll...!
So, let's keep this fun going!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start digging in!
Also, we should have the camera do a close-up of the first person to take a bite.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But who...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Eeny, meeny, miney...♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like Airi's choosing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just go with the flow!
Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku!
Show us what you got!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm very much looking forward to seeing how it tastes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I worried that it'd be too sweet because of all this whipped cream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the strawberries' tartness balances it all out! It's a wonderful combination!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you for noticing that!
We try to make the whipped cream not too sweet since that can become heavy and tiresome after a while...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: As for the strawberries, we tried many kinds until we found a cultivar that helps create the balance you just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, so quite a lot of work went into this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No fair, Shizuku!
I wanna try it too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, since Shizuku just gave us a good shot of her enjoying this, let's join her!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
Then, I'm also gonna start digging in!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How do the strawberries taste?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Th-They're really good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's really nice mix of sweet and sourness. I could eat a whole pile of these. How's the custard...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... It's delicious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This isn't just a matter of replacing words with others that mean the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But this really is good.
Like Shizuku said, it's very nicely balanced.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I like how the top and bottom halves leave different impressions in terms of taste. The part with the cornflakes and custard is nice and refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Despite how big it is, I can't seem to put down my spoon.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
I'm glad you're all enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a bit of a sweet tooth, but I don't see myself getting tired of this parfait anytime soon...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, I'll have to exercise quite a lot starting tomorrow if I'm going to work this all off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh nooo!
That's way too cute, Haruka! My brain's gonna overload if you keep saying stuff like that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm not sure what Haruka means by “exercise quite a lot”, but I get the feeling that she has a pretty grueling workout schedule in mind...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Have you had some yet, Airi? There might not be anything left for you if you don't hurry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, you should try some.
It really is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, stop moving your spoon towards your mouth!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They're probably gonna finish this whole thing themselves at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think this calls for a Happy Snacker. It's been far too long.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy Snacker?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
W-W-W-W-We get to see you do a Happy Snacker?! Right here...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold up...
What's a Happy Snacker?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's one of Happy Everyday's skills!
Whenever she eats something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, without further ado.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm. This is so yummy♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is one of her 1,000% Happy Idol Mode skills! She always looks so cute whenever she eats anything!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, you can sorta tell she's doing it on purpose, but I can see how this would make someone's heart flutter...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Airi!
It's been so long since I'd last seen you do a Happy Snacker!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
It's been so long that I'm so moved!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, this was originally meant for when I had to eat or drink really strange stuff like natto juice or wheatgrass stew for variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But this is beyond delicious!
I'm a Happy Snacker in every sense!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so glad I was scheduled to do this shift. I'm never gonna forget what I just saw for as long as I live...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me neither! I really gotta thank Airi again for inviting me to work here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's not as busy as I was expecting it to be. I'm starting to feel bad about being paid for this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We do have a group coming in later, but it's pretty calm today. We should be able to handle everything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
